title: Sound Pattern Playground
user: Students and hobbyists experimenting with their microphone who need to understand what an on-device sound classifier notices before training or embedding one.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA that records short user-consented clips, shows waveform/spectrogram/MFCC-like features, collects three labels, runs a transparent in-browser nearest-neighbor baseline, and exports the dataset.
success_measure: In a workshop, 80% of participants can collect three classes, explain one visible feature difference, and identify one misclassification in 25 minutes.
constraints: Never label people or infer sensitive traits; explicit microphone permission; local storage with obvious deletion; illustrative, non-diagnostic features.
